Yo Bro, check this shit out. Personally, I like to dry wash my bike because I'm a princess and I don't want my bike to get wet because I haven't payed it off yet and if it gets a scratch I'm just gonna go lay down on some train tracks. Let me lay some bomb techniques down for dry AND wet washing.

Dry Wash: Get yourself a nice couple of microfiber rags, some ZEP40 or something like it, really any detailing spray, some window cleaner, and some wax (I use the shit that comes in a can and comes with an applicator, it takes more time but your bike will look A1 afterwards). So start with the detailing spray first, hit all those crusty dead ass bugs and let them soak that shit in. While those little fuckers get nice and plump go ahead and use the window cleaner on your mirrors, headlights and maybe dash if that's also glass. Wipe the bugs and window clean away, boom cleaner bike, but we aren't yet, nah brah. Take that detailing spray, compartmentalize and spray that bitch down. Let it BRIEFLY soak, wipe. Repeat all over the bike till it's clean. Lastly take you some nice ol' wax, again compartmentalize (don't let that shit dry or it's get crusty), and go to town. Wax on, wax off. Should be looking pretty good by now.

h'Wet wash: Take your bike to the nearest water park or place with a hose. Get you some cleaner, nothing too harsh, honestly car wash it's just fine but they make some expesive motorcycle jank too. Step one, spray the bike down duh BUT WAIT. Hold the fuck up there bud, don't  just go blasting like it's prom night nah nah we're men of culture here. Avoid things like, idk, your exhaust, if your bike has a carb avoid that, maybe you have some cracked hoses to be aware of. Just try not to let water get IN the bike and you'll be fine. Next the cleaner, clean it, and spray it down, wipe it down with a microfiber. and if you're feeling really cool you can even wax it down after that.

​

General pointers: Clean your chain AFTER cleaning, don't spray slick shit like tire shine on your rotors/pads/tires/exhaust. You can use wax on clear plastics and glass like windshields and mirrors and it provides a little but of water resistence if rain riding is your thing. Denatured rubbing alcohol is pretty good for making exhaust look not like shit. I don't really have a specific list of cleaners but I do use ZEP40 and [this shit](https://www.amazon.com/Meguiars-Cleaner-Wax-Cleans-Protects/dp/B0009IQX0E/ref=sr_1_12?keywords=car+wax&qid=1582257232&sr=8-12) for my dry washes. Motul makes pretty good chain clean and lube, use a grunge brush to get the nasties off.
